identityClarification: Exactly TWO equipment groups matching original reference 1. LEFT: one compact wooden WINDLASS / STRING-TENSIONING FRAME seen from slightly above, as an equipment mechanism rather than an entire ballista cart: thick rear horizontal timber with two iron-capped upper brackets, thick front horizontal winding roller with iron end caps, two chunky side rails, central wooden guide plank, exposed rope lengths linking the corners and crossing across the front. ONE square iron winding housing at front with an L-shaped crank and short brown handle projecting toward lower-left. Two short simple timber feet at its base; NO wheels and NO bow arms beyond the reference. The top stays open so the broad internal planks and tension ropes remain visible. RIGHT: EXACTLY ONE separate thick short bolt, brown shaft with a few broad wrap bands, large triangular silver arrowhead pointing upper-right and faceted silver butt at bottom-left. No loaded extra bolt, no operator, no soldier or full wheeled cart.
